claim_judgments.rationale: Claim C0000 faithfully captures the introductory mandate in 40 CFR 262.11 that a person who generates a solid waste (as defined in 40 CFR 261.2) must make an accurate hazardous waste determination to ensure wastes are properly managed under RCRA regulations.

Claim C0001 accurately reproduces the timing and condition requirements of paragraph (a) for hazardous waste determinations, covering both the point of generation before alteration and subsequent management points where properties may have changed.
Claim C0002 accurately extracts the requirement from paragraph (b) that a person must determine whether the solid waste is excluded under 40 CFR 261.4 as part of the determination steps.

Claim C0003 properly captures the conditional requirement from paragraph (c) that if the waste is not excluded under 40 CFR 261.4, the generator must use knowledge to determine whether it meets listing descriptions under subpart D of 40 CFR part 261.
Claim C0004 accurately conveys the non-exhaustive list of acceptable knowledge types that may be used in determining whether a waste is listed under subpart D of 40 CFR part 261.
Claim C0005 correctly reflects the conditional permission in paragraph (c) allowing a person to file a delisting petition under 40 CFR 260.20 and 260.22 if the waste is listed.

unit_judgments.rationale: Unit U0000's requirement that a generator of solid waste make an accurate determination following the regulatory steps is fully covered by claim C0000.
Unit U0001 requires the determination to be made at the point of generation before alteration, which is fully covered within the compound statement of claim C0001.
Unit U0002 requires the determination to be made whenever waste properties change during management, which is fully covered within claim C0001.
Unit U0003 requires determining whether the waste is excluded under 40 CFR 261.4, which is faithfully retained in claim C0002.
Unit U0004 requires using knowledge to determine if non-excluded waste meets listing descriptions under subpart D of 40 CFR part 261, completely covered in claim C0003.
Unit U0005 permits the use of various categories of acceptable knowledge to evaluate whether a waste is listed, completely represented in claim C0004.
Unit U0006 permits filing a delisting petition under 40 CFR 260.20 and 260.22 if the waste is listed, fully preserved in claim C0005.
